scenarios.name: Explicit installation only
scenarios.given: the optional search model is absent
scenarios.then: no download starts and the pinned public model inventory remains fixed

scenarios.name: Verified local installation
scenarios.given: the user explicitly installs the optional model
scenarios.then: only complete size/hash-verified files become available and a new owner can reopen them without downloading

scenarios.name: Invalid download cleanup
scenarios.given: a public model download has wrong bytes or size
scenarios.then: the model stays unavailable and only this attempt staging is removed

scenarios.name: Cancelled download
scenarios.given: an optional model download is pending
scenarios.when: installation is cancelled before its late producer returns
scenarios.then: no model becomes available and temporary files are removed

scenarios.name: Removal revokes an in-flight installation
scenarios.given: a model download ignores cancellation until it returns
scenarios.when: the user removes the optional model
scenarios.then: the owned download finishes cleanup without restoring removed files or reporting late progress, and later explicit installation remains possible

scenarios.name: Local integrity and removal
scenarios.given: an installed optional model has a corrupted, missing or symlinked asset
scenarios.when: History checks readiness and the user removes it
scenarios.then: it is unavailable without a download and removal leaves unrelated external bytes intact

scenarios.name: Model ownership never follows external links
scenarios.given: the model owner directory or a non-system ancestor is a symlink to an existing external model
scenarios.when: readiness, installation or removal is requested
scenarios.then: readiness stays unavailable, explicit actions refuse before downloading or deleting, and the external model remains unchanged

scenarios.name: Downloaded links cannot modify other files
scenarios.given: a downloader returns a symbolic link to an external file
scenarios.then: installation refuses without changing the external bytes or permissions

scenarios.name: Changed owner cannot redirect staging cleanup
scenarios.given: a public model download is pending in its owned staging folder
scenarios.when: the owner folder is moved and replaced with a link to an external folder containing a same-named stage
scenarios.then: installation refuses, external bytes remain intact and original staging is preserved for safe later cleanup
